caption: Admin home: managers, coordinators, teachers, children, classes, workers, schools and this week’s lessons at a glance.
Every teacher with email, phone, subjects, curriculum and classes; the row menu holds Message, Assignments, Edit, Reset password and Disable account.
Subject coordinators with their scope (grade, subject, curriculum) and contact details.
School managers and the curriculum each one runs.
Non-teaching staff — driver, nurse, caretaker — with job and phone.
Children with their class and parent (name, email, phone), searchable and paged.
Admitting a child: class, child’s name and the parent login that is created with it.
All 30 classes by curriculum and grade, with teachers, roster size and the class join code.
Copying a class’s join code to hand to parents; the code puts a child straight into that class.
A conversation with a parent: text, a photo and a PDF, with read state and the reply box.
The Admin sees every complaint in the school and its history, but answering is left to the recipient.
The school card on Home: the logo shown in the menu and on the sign-in page, with Replace and Remove.
The bell opens the latest notifications — new messages and complaints — with Mark all as read.
The same Home in Arabic: the whole dashboard mirrors right-to-left.
